Frequently asked questions

Know what to expect.

What happens during the free consultation?

We talk about your business, customers, marketing, challenges, and goals. I identify opportunities and help you create a customized Digital Marketing Plan with clear next steps.

Is the consultation really free?

Yes. The goal is to understand your business, identify useful opportunities, and see whether I can help you further.

Do I need to understand AI?

No. I focus on making AI practical and easy to understand. You only need to know how it can help your business.

Do you only provide AI services?

No. AI is one part of the strategy. I also help with digital marketing strategy, lead generation, social media, advertising, content, automation, and conversion optimization.

What type of businesses do you help?

I mainly help small and medium businesses that want to improve their online marketing, generate more leads, and grow sales.

I already do digital marketing. Can you still help?

Yes. We can review what you are already doing, identify weak points, find missed opportunities, and look for ways AI can make your marketing more efficient.
